what: A revision case cannot plant a bug in the daemon (plants are `#[cfg(test)]` thread-locals of unit tests) and cannot bound inputs written (`max_inputs` does not exist), so the control of a real-driver case needed a request variable read by the daemon (`BLAZE_FRONT_END_PER_PLAN`), and `no input written` is asserted only in blaze-lower's unit test.
cost: a control knob in production code; one invariant checked a level below where it was asked for
cause: the revision harness observes a real daemon only through what `blaze why` and `blaze explain` print
whys: a planted bug must be in the binary under test
the daemon binary is built without `cfg(test)`
prevention: proposed to lane sound-1112: an `inputs` expectation (`max_inputs`) read from the profile's write counts, and a documented list of control variables the daemon reads of a request
workaround: `BLAZE_FRONT_END_PER_PLAN=1`, read of the request alone, with the miss listed as `known` in the control case
